title: Koh Samet: real sounds
kaylee: The whole Samet trip sounds real now: the speedboat and jet ski roar and splash, sand scrunches when she digs, the reef bubbles, the fire poi whooshes, and every beach has waves.
questions: Name any sounds to redo (like "jetski 2" or "finale 5"), or "none".
Snorkeling has bubbles but no breathing through the tube (it can sound spooky). Add a soft breath: yes or no?
